bundle.shortDescription: PDFs to Markdown, checked against the PDF, on your own GPU
bundle.longDescription: Sift turns PDFs into Markdown with their images, image descriptions and a report of anything it could not verify. Two local models (surya 2.5 and Gemma 4 E4B) run on official llama.cpp builds; nothing leaves the computer.
